title: LiteParse PDF quality and speed
finding: Validation gate for OpenSpec change `use-liteparse-as-pdf-reader`. H1 PASS (+6.9% nDCG@10, 100% vs 96% Hit@5). H2 FAIL (parsing 5.5× faster but embedding dominates; LiteParse extracts 15% more chunks). H3 FAIL (corpus saturation). H4 PASS. LiteParse adopted via factory (ADR-020).
